scope: Theorem 12.8 (A bounded-box event with a vertical routing guard) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 59. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every machine and finite input, and fixed positive computable viscosity, there is an effective smooth force on R3 with uniformly compact spatial support, bounded mixed derivatives and period one for t ≥ 1, whose zero-data solution satisfies ∃t ≥ 0 : X(t; (2, 0, 0)) ∈ (0, 1) × (0, 1) × (−1, 1) ⇐⇒ the machine halts. The constructed solution is smooth with pressure zero. It is unique among smooth solutions with u ∈ CtH2 ∩ C1 t L2, bounded u on each finite interval, and p ∈ CtH1. This comparison class requires no bound on the competing velocity’s spatial gradient.
